items.title: SkyW4lker Phishing Campaign Expands, Threatening US Enterprises with Microsoft 365 Account Takeovers
items.description: A phishing kit called SkyW4lker (also branded SkyW4lker x365 Sentinel) is quietly taking over Microsoft 365 accounts without ever stealing a password. Instead of cracking logins or breaking MFA, it tricks employees into approving a legitimate Microsoft device-code sign-in, handing attackers a valid session to corporate mailboxes, documents, and connected apps. If uploads use the Disk service, the same upload can make the server read files too.
